{{Quote|Heard rumors about this Onslaught--chock-full of wild beasts and Terror Brigade wackos. Command has given my squad permission to try, but I doubt our odds are good. [...] That Onslaught was designed to break their strongest warriors.|Lieutenant [[Calia]]|<ref name="TOR:TTB" />}}
The '''Onslaught''' referred to a combat challenge created by the [[Terror Brigade]] group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:TTB">{{TORcite|type=heroic|The Terror Brigade|Hoth}}</ref>
